hero.title: Wood as Medium, Minimalist Aesthetics
hero.subtitle: Return to nature, touch the pure texture

brand.title: Heritage of Craftsmanship, Soul of Nature
brand.desc1: Foshan Jincu Furniture Co., Ltd. was founded in 2008, originating from a craftsmanship-oriented factory established in 2004. Based in Lecong, Foshan—the "Furniture Capital of China"—we have dedicated two decades to the foodservice and hospitality furniture industry, growing into an industry leader integrating R&D, production, and sales.
brand.desc2: We operate a 30,000㎡ modern production base and a 5,000㎡ immersive showroom. Equipped with international machinery, staffed by experienced artisans, and driven by refined management, we ensure every product meets the highest standards of excellence. Our furniture is exported worldwide, serving over 3,000 chain brands annually with tailored solutions, and enjoys an 80% customer repurchase rate. Our philosophy: Win-win cooperation, customer first.

products.title: Product Center
products.subtitle: Not just furniture, but art
products.page_subtitle: Explore our complete collection of handcrafted furniture, designed to bring nature into your home.

zen_table.name: Zen · Solid Wood Coffee Table
zen_table.desc: Inspired by Zen philosophy, this coffee table features a low profile and clean lines. Made from premium solid walnut, it brings a sense of calm and stability to your living room.

oak_chair.name: Simple · Oak Dining Chair
oak_chair.desc: A minimalist dining chair that prioritizes comfort and durability. The curved backrest provides excellent support, while the white oak finish adds a touch of brightness.

silent_wardrobe.name: Quiet · Bedroom Wardrobe
silent_wardrobe.desc: Designed for a peaceful bedroom environment. This wardrobe features soft-close doors and ample storage space, crafted from sustainable ash wood.

cloud_bookshelf.name: Cloud Hidden · Bookshelf Combination
cloud_bookshelf.desc: Modular bookshelf system that can be customized to fit your space. The open design creates an airy feel, perfect for displaying your favorite books and objects.

nature_bed.name: True · Wooden Bed
nature_bed.desc: Return to the basics with this solid cherry wood bed frame. The natural grain patterns are highlighted by a hand-rubbed oil finish.

flow_cabinet.name: Flowing Light · Side Cabinet
flow_cabinet.desc: A versatile side cabinet with a unique wave-patterned door. It serves as both a functional storage unit and a beautiful accent piece.

minimal_sofa.name: Minimal · Fabric Sofa
minimal_sofa.desc: Clean lines meet ultimate comfort. Upholstered in premium natural linen with a solid oak frame, this sofa is the epitome of understated luxury.

rattan_chair.name: Breeze · Rattan Chair
rattan_chair.desc: Hand-woven natural rattan combined with a solid wood structure. Lightweight yet durable, it brings a relaxed, organic vibe to any room.

glass_cabinet.name: Clear · Glass Cabinet
glass_cabinet.desc: Showcase your treasured items in this elegant glass and wood cabinet. The tempered glass doors keep dust out while allowing full visibility.

craftsmanship.title: Craftsmanship
craftsmanship.subtitle: From forest to home, every step is a tribute to nature

selection.title: Wood Selection
selection.desc: Deep into global primeval forests, selecting high-quality hardwoods over 50 years old to ensure stability.

drying.title: Natural Drying
drying.desc: 180 days of natural seasoning and drying to eliminate internal stress and prevent cracking and deformation.

polishing.title: Fine Polishing
polishing.desc: 12 manual polishing processes to retain the natural texture of the wood, making it feel as warm as baby skin.

coating.title: Eco Coating
coating.desc: Using German imported plant wood wax oil, 0 formaldehyde and pollution-free, allowing the wood to breathe freely.
